The '''Thanos shipyards''' were a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thanos]], in the [[Thanos system|Togoria system]] of [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> By the time of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was considered as one of the 67 major shipyards of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], it was operated by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> and kept under tight control,<ref name="TEA" /> to produce [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The presence of the shipyards prevented the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]] living on the neighboring world of [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]] to revolt against the Empire.<ref name="TT">''[[Star Wars Missions 8: Togorian Trap]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet Thanos and its shipyard fell under control of [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]]. Thanos was eventually [[Battle of Thanos|captured]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
